onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to MintCat
onboarding.welcome.description: MintCat is a mod manager and integration tool for Deep Rock Galactic and more. Here's a quick overview of each section.
onboarding.configImport.title: Import Config
onboarding.configImport.description: If you have config from an older version or another PC, you can import it here. Click the button below to open the config import window, then close it and click Next.
onboarding.gameSelect.title: Select Game
onboarding.gameSelect.description: Choose the game to manage and set its install path. Click the highlighted "Select Game" button below to open the dialog, then close it and click Next.
onboarding.home.title: Home · Mod List
onboarding.home.description: Manage your mods, groups, enable/disable mods, and run "Integrate" to install the current profile into the game.
onboarding.switchProfile.title: Switch profile
onboarding.switchProfile.description: Switch between different mod profiles here. You can create multiple profiles and change between them anytime.
onboarding.save.title: Save
onboarding.save.description: After enabling/disabling mods or changing groups, click Save to write the current profile; then click Launch in the title bar to install into the game.
onboarding.addMod.title: Add Mod
onboarding.addMod.description: Click here to open the Add Mod dialog. You can add mods from local files, mod.io links, or clipboard to the current profile.
onboarding.launch.title: Launch
onboarding.launch.description: Click here to integrate the current profile into the game and then launch.
onboarding.switchGame.title: Switch game
onboarding.switchGame.description: Click here to select or switch the current game (e.g. Deep Rock Galactic, Rogue Core). Each game has its own mod profiles.
onboarding.modio.title: mod.io · Search & Add
onboarding.modio.description: Search and download mods from mod.io, ModCat, Nexus Mods, Thunderstore, or add from local files.
onboarding.setting.title: Settings
onboarding.setting.description: Configure game path, theme, language, cloud backup, and more. We recommend choosing your game and install path here first.
onboarding.userSettings.title: User Settings
onboarding.userSettings.description: Click here to open User Settings and manage account sign-in and access keys for mod.io, ModCat, and other platforms for searching and downloading mods.
onboarding.end.title: Get Started
onboarding.end.description: That's it. You can find help or send feedback in Settings anytime. Enjoy!
